speed: n/a (locked frame, held to the end of the group)
start_frame: Straight across the hall from the south-east doors to the low curtain, lens flat on the floor: she lies down on her side and one enormous human eye comes to the fifteen-inch horseshoe-arched opening, the dark mass of her body running out of frame both ways.
end_frame: The same frame held: summer green-gold light laid in a hard bar across that one eye, the eye undistorted and anatomically real, the 0.38 m arch keeping its true size beside it — the last garden daylight in the episode.
constraint_honoured: 'Held to the end of the group — this is the image the climax then breaks.'
movement_note: 50 mm and a locked frame so neither the eye nor the arch bends; a wider lens or a move would turn the best image in the episode into an effect.
